courses.title: VLSI Design & Verification Using Verilog HDL
courses.domain: VLSI Design & Verification Using Verilog HDL
courses.description: This internship program focuses on the software-oriented aspects of VLSI design, including Verilog HDL programming, RTL design, digital circuit simulation, and functional verification. Students will gain practical experience using industry-relevant EDA tools, writing and debugging HDL code, designing digital systems, and verifying hardware functionality through software-based simulation and project development.
courses.syllabus:
Module 1: Introduction to VLSI Design and EDA Tools

Module 2: Digital Electronics and Logic Design

Module 3: Verilog HDL Programming Fundamentals

Module 4: RTL Design and Coding Techniques

Module 5: Digital Circuit Simulation Using EDA Tools

Module 6: Functional Verification and Testbench Development

Module 7: FPGA Design and Implementation Basics

Module 8: Final Project – Design, Simulation and Verification of a Digital System

modules.title: Introduction to VLSI Design
modules.description: This module introduces students to the fundamentals of Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) design. Students will learn about integrated circuits (ICs), semiconductor chips, the evolution and applications of VLSI technology, and the differences between ASIC and FPGA. The module also explains VLSI Frontend and Backend design, along with the complete VLSI design flow. By the end of this module, students will understand the basic concepts of VLSI technology and its role in modern electronics, preparing them for RTL design and Verilog HDL programming in upcoming modules.
